# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the outer RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Executes a single RED→GREEN→REFACTOR cycle with retries and learning |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | Language-specific pod that delegates code generation and container execution |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates test, implementation, and refactor code via LLM prompts |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines the next test increment using LLM and prior context |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer with security breach detection |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Manages container lifecycle and file pulse execution |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Core playbook CRUD with semantic dedup, safety screening, and persistence |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Logs TDD cycles and ML experiments to DB with fallback to SQLite |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified client for multiple LLM providers (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes task outcomes to extract error patterns and root causes |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesises reflector insights into playbook delta bullets |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM with bullet retrieval |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance data |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Aggregates audit trail into anonymized agent performance metrics |
| AuditStore | src/audit/store.py | Append-only audit store with hash chain integrity verification |
| LocalAuditClient | src/audit/local_client.py | Writes audit events directly to local SQLite database |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter.py | Static security filter that rejects forbidden imports and builtins |
| RedundancyPreChecker | src/agents/redundancy_checker.py | Pre-checks proposed tests for redundancy before the RED phase |
| TestReviewAgent | src/agents/test_review_agent.py | Validates test quality before implementation phase |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src/agents/gherkin_feature_bridge.py | Parses .feature files into structured FeatureSpec objects |
| EnsembleBuildRunner | src/agents/ensemble_build.py | Drives multi-candidate blind builds across multiple models |
| PolyglotTDDRunner | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates RED→GREEN→REFACTOR across multiple LanguagePods |
| ContractArchitect | src/contracts/contract_architect.py | Generates interface contracts from natural language requirements |
| ModuleArchitect | src/contracts/module_architect.py | Generates module-level contracts for stateful systems |
| ModuleTDDBuilder | src/contracts/module_tdd_builder.py | Builds module implementations using TDD per function |
| ProjectArchitect | src/contracts/project_architect.py | Decomposes project specs into module dependency graphs |
| ProjectBuilder | src/cli/project_builder.py | Builds all modules of a project plan in dependency order |
| ContextMapBuilder | src/utils/context_map.py | Builds AST signature maps from source files for context injection |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src/retrieval/service.py | Central knowledge retrieval with playbook and cross-model queries |
| ContextScorer | src/retrieval/context_scorer.py | Scores bullets against temporal, team, tech-stack, and domain context |
| ContextGraphRetriever | src/retrieval/cgr3_retriever.py | CGR³ pipeline: retrieve, rank, reason, and return verdicts |
| SimulationPod | src/agents/simulation_pod.py | LanguagePod for PyBullet simulation TDD cycles |
| GoLanguagePod | src/agents/go_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Go TDD cycles |
| TypeScriptLanguagePod | src/agents/typescript_language_pod.py | LanguagePod for TypeScript TDD cycles via vitest |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Main as main()
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant LLM as LLMClient
    participant PodmanOrch as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant PodmanCtr as PodmanRunner
    participant Reflect as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Audit as LocalAuditClient

    Main->>Runner: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    activate Runner
    loop for each cycle up to max_iterations
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        activate Planner
        Planner-->>Runner: PodSpec
        deactivate Planner
        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle

        Note over Cycle,Pod: RED phase
        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        activate Worker
        Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
        activate LLM
        LLM-->>Worker: code response
        deactivate LLM
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        deactivate Worker
        Pod->>PodmanOrch: pulse(files)
        activate PodmanOrch
        PodmanOrch->>PodmanCtr: send_pulse(files)
        activate PodmanCtr
        PodmanCtr-->>PodmanOrch: PulseResult
        deactivate PodmanCtr
        PodmanOrch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate PodmanOrch
        Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult
        deactivate Pod

        Note over Cycle,Pod: GREEN phase (with retries)
        loop up to max_green_attempts
            Cycle->>Pod: run_green(retry_spec)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_feedback)
            activate Worker
            Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
            activate LLM
            LLM-->>Worker: code response
            deactivate LLM
            Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
            deactivate Worker
            Pod->>PodmanOrch: pulse(files)
            PodmanOrch->>PodmanCtr: send_pulse(files)
            PodmanCtr-->>PodmanOrch: PulseResult
            PodmanOrch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult
            deactivate Pod
            alt passed or abort
                break
            else
                Cycle->>Cycle: set error_feedback for next retry
            end
        end

        Note over Cycle,Pod: REFACTOR phase
        Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_refactor(spec)
        activate Worker
        Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
        activate LLM
        LLM-->>Worker: refactored_code
        deactivate LLM
        Worker-->>Pod: refactored_code
        deactivate Worker
        Pod->>PodmanOrch: pulse(files)
        PodmanOrch->>PodmanCtr: send_pulse(files)
        PodmanCtr-->>PodmanOrch: PulseResult
        PodmanOrch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult
        deactivate Pod

        alt green passed or stagnant failure
            Cycle->>Reflect: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
            activate Reflect
            Reflect-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
            deactivate Reflect
            Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
            activate Curator
            Curator->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
            activate Playbook
            Playbook-->>Curator: added bullet ids
            deactivate Playbook
            Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
            deactivate Curator
        end

        Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
        activate Logger
        Logger-->>Cycle: experiment record
        deactivate Logger

        Cycle->>Audit: emit_simple(TEST_GENERATED)
        Cycle->>Audit: emit_simple(IMPLEMENTATION_GENERATED)
        Cycle->>Audit: emit_simple(PATTERN_LEARNED)
        Cycle->>Audit: emit_simple(CYCLE_COMPLETED)

        Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult
        deactivate Cycle

        alt complete or max iterations reached
            break
        end
    end
    Runner-->>Main: IterativeResult
    deactivate Runner
```
